scenario: Status flip on cortical sulci + sinus normal denying mucosal thickening + a one-region pred statement covering two gt statements (1:N)
description: Adapted from brain-mr/findings_{gt,pred}/example_1 (negative scan in gt, pred adds two abnormalities and summarizes the posterior fossa in one statement). Demonstrates a status flip on hemispheric cortical sulci (gt 'compatible with age' = normal vs pred 'mildly prominent for age' = abnormal — INC downstream), an organ-level normal statement denying an abnormality (gt 'Paranasal sinuses are normal' vs pred left maxillary sinus mucosal thickening — a status inversion, matched), and a one-region pred statement ('Posterior fossa structures are normal') bound to both gt statements it covers (1:N).

pred_findings.text: Hemispheric cortical sulcal widths are mildly prominent for the patient's age.
Mucosal thickening in the left maxillary sinus.

gt_findings.text: Medulla oblongata, pons, mesencephalon are normal.
Both cerebellar hemispheres and vermis parenchyma are normal.
Hemispheric cortical sulcal widths are compatible with the patient's age.

matches.reasoning: Pred's posterior fossa statement covers the medulla, pons and mesencephalon.
The same statement also covers the cerebellar hemispheres and vermis.
Same cortical sulci, normal in gt and prominent in pred.
Organ-level 'paranasal sinuses normal' denies the left maxillary mucosal thickening.
